headline: 侠探杰克双榜领跑，影剧市场冰火两重天
headlineEn: Jack Reacher dominates both charts; film and TV markets heat up
summary: 今日无新片上映，但本周8部新片蓄势待发。《侠探杰克》同时称霸电影与剧集热度榜，《绿灯军团》成剧集黑马，《怒之杀》《最后的曙光》领跑电影周榜。
summaryEn: No movies hit theaters today, but 8 new films arrive this week. 'Reacher' tops both movie and TV charts, 'Green Lantern Corps' is a TV dark horse, and 'Rage of Kill' and 'The Last Dawn' lead film momentum.

industryHighlights.text: 今日无新片上映，本周累计8部新片登场。
industryHighlights.en: No movie releases today; 8 new movies debut this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《侠探杰克》同时登顶电影与剧集双榜。
industryHighlights.en: 'Reacher' tops both movie and TV charts simultaneously.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》在剧集和电影周榜均表现抢眼。
industryHighlights.en: 'Green Lantern Corps' impresses on both weekly TV and movie charts.

industryHighlights.text: 《早春晴朗》《黑色丽人》等新剧进入今日剧集热榜。
industryHighlights.en: Dramas like 'Early Spring Sunshine' and 'Dark Beauty' enter today's TV top trends.

industryHighlights.text: 近期暂无重大定档项目。
industryHighlights.en: No notable upcoming releases are scheduled.
